title: How is MatPat connected to Napoleon?
description:
Congress, a president, two queens and two paintings link MatPat to Napoleon.

MatPat → Yvette Clarke → Nancy Pelosi → Barack Obama → Elizabeth II → Mary of Teck → Queen Victoria → Napoleon III → Napoleon

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.
